environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with direct internet-facing ALB. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. Origin server directly accessible via ALB DNS name. DEBUG_KEY is set to a weak value 'debug123'. No session TTL enforcement. Application runs as NODE_ENV=development.

config.load_balancer: ALB with public DNS, no WAF
config.cloudfront: distribution exists but origin also directly reachable
